title: Which number does Claude pick? 221 "random number between 1 and 100" prompts to Claude Haiku 4.5, Sonnet 5.5 and Opus 5.5
description: Every answer from 221 fresh "Pick a random number between 1 and 100" prompts to three Claude models, plus 225 prompts for 1 to 10,000. Haiku 4.5 only ever answered 47 or 42; Sonnet 5.5 said 47 in 92% of asks; Opus 5.5 said 42 in 61%. For 1 to 10,000, 221 of 225 answers contained a 7. Includes the collection script. Write-up: https://saeedseo.com/blog/reddit-post-one-million-views/
